stem:
The time, $X$ hours, taken by a large number of people to complete a challenge is modelled by the probability density function given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{1}{x^2} & a \leqslant x \leqslant b, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $a$ and $b$ are constants.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what the constants $a$ and $b$ represent in this context.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Show that $b = 2$ and find the value of $a$.
